data.name: Dawud
data.gender_notes: Dawud is used as a male name in islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The Arabic form of the Hebrew David, from the root d-w-d, 'beloved'. Its root is Hebrew d-w-d. The prophet Dāwūd (David), who received the Zabūr (Psalms). Dawud is a Arabic name meaning “Beloved”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Dawud expresses “Beloved”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: The Arabic form of the Hebrew David, from the root d-w-d, 'beloved'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Dawud total 17, reducing to 8. Number 8 is associated with ambition, authority and material mastery.
